# Scribophile

> Scribophile is an online writing workshop and community platform where serious writers receive manuscript feedback, participate in peer critiques, and connect with beta readers and fellow authors.

Scribophile provides a comprehensive ecosystem for writers including daily writing sprints, writing contests with cash prizes, craft education through its Writing Academy, and active community forums. The platform combines peer critique, beta reader matching, and educational resources to support writers at all stages of their publishing journey.

## Key Topics

- Writing community
- Peer critique system
- Manuscript feedback
- Beta readers
- Writing workshop
- Writing contests
- Writing craft
- Creative writing
- Writing forums
- Online writing sprints
- Writer network
- Publishing support
- Story improvement
- Writing Academy
- Member karma rewards

## Core Features & Community

- [Scribophile Homepage](https://www.scribophile.com): Homepage for Scribophile online writing workshop and community platform
- [Meet Beta Readers](https://www.scribophile.com/beta-readers): Connect with beta readers and get manuscript feedback in writing community
- [Writing Forums](https://www.scribophile.com/writing-forums): Active forums for writing craft discussion, critiques, and writer networking
- [Writing Together: Daily Writing Sprints](https://www.scribophile.com/writing-together): Daily free Zoom writing sprints for focused accountability and community

## Contests & Opportunities

- [Writing Contests](https://www.scribophile.com/writing-contests): Free writing contests with cash prizes and karma rewards for members
- [Markets & Contests Newsletter](https://www.scribophile.com/newsletters/markets-and-contests): Newsletter signup for writing markets, contests, and submission opportunities

## Learning Resources

- [Writing Academy](https://www.scribophile.com/academy): Free writing craft articles covering grammar, literary devices, fundamentals

## Membership & Account

- [Create a Scribophile Account](https://www.scribophile.com/join): Account signup page for free and premium Scribophile membership

## Support & Guidelines

- [Help Center](https://www.scribophile.com/help): Help center with getting started guides, FAQs, and community support
- [FAQ](https://www.scribophile.com/help/faq): FAQs covering IP rights, plagiarism, publishing, and member concerns
- [Codes of Conduct](https://www.scribophile.com/help/codes-of-conduct): Community guidelines for authors, critiquers, and forum participation
- [Contact Us](https://www.scribophile.com/contact): Contact form for customer support, account issues, and inquiries

## Optional

- [Terms of Service](https://www.scribophile.com/join/terms): Legal terms of service covering user accounts and obligations
